content.short: Cropty Wallet is a crypto wallet for storing, sending, buying, selling, and earning with TON and other assets.
content.description: Cropty Wallet is a consumer crypto wallet built for everyday account and asset management across supported coins. Its public product pages focus on storing balances, sending transfers, buying and selling assets, and using in app earning features from one interface. The wallet supports Toncoin alongside other cryptocurrencies, making it a practical choice for users who want simple access to payments and portfolio actions without depending on a trading first product or a more technical self custody setup.
content.meta: Cropty Wallet offers TON users storage, transfers, buying, selling, and earning features in a wallet designed for everyday crypto activity.
